# VoxelRust base content.  (Generated by tools/gen_base.py; hand edits are fine too.)
#
# Everything in the game world is declared here: textures, blocks and items.
# This file is built into the game; a pack file (see docs/DATA.md) is read
# after it and may add to it or redefine anything by reusing its id.
#
#   texture <id> builtin <painter>            a built-in procedural texture
#   texture <id> paint <style> <r> <g> <b>    a built-in pattern in any colour
#   texture <id> flat <r> <g> <b> [noise n]   a plain colour with some grain
#   texture <id> file <image.tga>             a 16x16 TGA next to the pack file
#
#   block <id>
#     name <display name>
#     shape cube | cutout | translucent | cross | liquid | slab | stairs | fence | wall
#     box x0 y0 z0 x1 y1 z1                   custom shape, in 1/16ths of a block
#     tex <all>   or   tex <top> <side> <bottom>
#     light <0..15>      skyloss <0..15>      solid yes|no
#     hardness <seconds> drops <item>|nothing category <tab name>
#     rotate             four facings, placed facing the player
#     flip               also upside-down, placed by where you aim
#     unbreakable        hidden (no item)
#
#   item <id>
#     name <display name>     icon <texture>      category <tab name>
#     place <block>           brush <radius>      reach <blocks>     stack <n>

# ---- Stairs, slabs, walls and fences ----
# `shape stairs` is two boxes plus `rotate` and `flip`; `shape slab` is one box
# plus `flip`. `shape wall` and `shape fence` join up with their neighbours.

  stack 1

# ---- Recipes (survival mode) ----

# ---- Models and creatures ----
#   model <id> builtin <name>            a model shipped with the game
#   model <id> file <model.bbmodel>      a Blockbench model next to the data file
#
#   entity <id>
#     name <display name>      model <model id>      tint <r> <g> <b>
#     height <blocks>          width <blocks>        speed <blocks per second>
#     health <points>          damage <points>       weight <spawn chance>
#     behavior wander | npc | hostile | swim
#     biomes <names...>        night (appears only after dark)
#     drops <item> <count>     what it leaves when killed in survival
model player builtin player
model grazer builtin grazer

entity wanderer
  name Wanderer
  model player
  height 1.8
  width 0.6
  speed 2.6
  health 20
  behavior npc
  weight 6
entity lurker
  name Lurker
  model player
  tint 70 110 90
  height 1.9
  width 0.6
  speed 3.1
  health 14
  damage 3
  behavior hostile
  night
  weight 30

# ---- Vehicles ----
# The base game has none of its own: boats, trains, planes and cars are
# mods (mods/boats, mods/trains, mods/planes, mods/landvehicles), written
# with `vehicle` blocks as described in docs/DATA.md.

# ---- Caves ----
# The terrain generator dresses caves with these, region by region.
#   hurts <n>   standing in or on it costs that much health a second
#   slow <pct>  walking through it is that slow

# ---- Sounds ----
# Every sound is made on the spot from a burst of noise and a gliding tone.
#   sound <id> <effects|steps|ui> <seconds> <noise 0..1> <hz from> <hz to> <low-pass 0..1> <loudness> [caption]
# The caption is what subtitles show. Redefine an id to retune a sound; give
# blocks `sound <id>` (breaking and placing) and creatures `sound <id>` (their call).
sound step steps 0.09 0.95 90 60 0.10 0.55 Footsteps
sound break effects 0.22 0.90 160 70 0.30 0.80 Block breaks
sound place effects 0.10 0.70 220 140 0.22 0.70 Block placed
sound hurt effects 0.25 0.25 420 180 0.50 0.80 Something is hurt
sound click ui 0.05 0.20 900 700 0.80 0.45
sound pop effects 0.08 0.10 500 900 0.80 0.50 Item picked up
sound splash effects 0.35 1.00 100 100 0.45 0.60 Splash
sound thunder effects 1.80 1.00 60 40 0.04 1.00 Thunder
sound rain effects 0.45 1.00 100 100 0.60 0.22 Rain
sound rumble effects 0.60 0.90 46 34 0.03 0.90 The ground rumbles
sound wave effects 1.60 1.00 80 60 0.07 0.30 Waves
sound glass effects 0.18 0.55 1800 900 0.90 0.60 Glass breaks
sound wood effects 0.14 0.75 240 150 0.25 0.75 Wood knocks
sound door effects 0.16 0.60 180 120 0.20 0.70 Door
sound bow effects 0.20 0.30 240 520 0.60 0.60 Bowstring
sound moo effects 0.70 0.05 150 110 0.30 0.50 Cow lows
sound baa effects 0.45 0.10 420 340 0.40 0.45 Sheep bleats
sound oink effects 0.25 0.35 260 180 0.30 0.50 Pig grunts
sound cluck effects 0.12 0.15 700 500 0.60 0.40 Hen clucks
sound bark effects 0.14 0.30 420 260 0.50 0.60 Dog barks
sound meow effects 0.40 0.05 700 520 0.60 0.40 Cat meows
sound howl effects 1.40 0.05 320 520 0.50 0.55 Wolf howls
sound growl effects 0.60 0.60 110 80 0.15 0.70 Growling
sound hiss effects 0.50 1.00 100 100 0.95 0.35 Hissing
sound chirp effects 0.10 0.02 2400 3200 0.90 0.30 Bird chirps
sound buzz effects 0.40 0.20 210 230 0.70 0.20 Buzzing
sound groan effects 0.90 0.30 120 80 0.20 0.60 Groaning
sound rattle effects 0.30 0.85 900 700 0.85 0.45 Bones rattle
sound roar effects 1.20 0.70 140 60 0.12 1.00 A roar
sound chime effects 0.60 0.02 1200 1180 0.90 0.40 Chime
sound rail effects 0.12 0.80 300 260 0.35 0.35 Cart on rails
sound whoosh effects 0.35 1.00 100 100 0.30 0.50 Whoosh
sound sizzle effects 0.50 1.00 100 100 0.90 0.25 Sizzling

# ---- Dimensions ----
# Other worlds inside each world, with their own land and their own saved
# chunks: /dim NAME goes there, /dim home comes back. Packs add their own
# and may send players through with scripts (a portal block, say).
#   dimension <name> <normal|flat|void|islands>
dimension sky islands
dimension flatland flat
dimension void void
dimension mirror normal

# ---- Things that open ----
#   toggle <block>   right click swaps the block for another (and back)
#   tall             two blocks high: placed, broken and toggled together
# Describe the shape as seen when the player faces north while placing.
texture oak_door paint door 176 136 84
block oak_door
  name Oak Door
  tex oak_door
  category Doors
  hardness 1.2
  tool axe
  rotate
  box 0 0 13 16 16 16
  toggle oak_door_open
  tall

  toggle oak_door

  tall

# ---- Farming ----
#   item ... turns <block> <block>   right click turns one block into another
#   block ... on <blocks>            may only stand on these; pops off otherwise
#   block ... grows <block> <secs>   becomes that block after about that long
#   block ... also <item> [chance] [count]   a second thing given when broken
#   block ... falls                  drops when nothing is under it
